payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the Greenland Ice Sheet (GrIS) melts before the Antarctic Ice Sheet (AIS) due to specific climatic conditions during the Last Interglacial (LIG), which are linked to continental levering and ocean syphoning effects.

claims.text: The Greenland Ice Sheet (GrIS) melts first, contributing to an early peak in sea level during the Last Interglacial (LIG).
The melting of the GrIS is driven by climatic conditions that precede the melting of the Antarctic Ice Sheet (AIS).
